guard: The fork cut: computed in migration mode, ending before the step it names, inheriting the parent pins verbatim, and committed with the child record written last.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/fork-cut.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd

mutations.name: the cut includes the very step it was cut at
mutations.find:
if (stepKeyString(key) === this.cutAt) throw new CutReached(this.cutAt);
    return super.lookup(key, inputHash);
mutations.expectRed: the step forked at is NOT in the cut: the child re-runs it
mutations.cell: the step forked at is NOT in the cut: the child re-runs it

mutations.name: the cut is computed in RESUME mode
mutations.expectRed: the real plan reaches a cut inside a settled scope, because it walks in migration mode
mutations.cell: the real plan reaches a cut inside a settled scope, because it walks in migration mode

mutations.name: the child is reseeded from its own run id
mutations.find: await createRunSpec(kv, endpoint, plan.child, { pins: plan.pins, createdAt: plan.at });
mutations.replace: await createRunSpec(kv, endpoint, plan.child, { pins: { ...plan.pins, seed: plan.child }, createdAt: plan.at });
mutations.expectRed: it is pinned to the parent's seed, so the copied prefix decides what it decided
mutations.cell: and it is pinned to the parent's seed, so the copied prefix decides what it decided

mutations.name: the record is written FIRST, so a crash leaves a drivable half-fork
mutations.expectRed: leaves NO record behind: the spec is written last
mutations.cell: and leaves NO record behind: the spec is written last

mutations.name: a cut that was never reached is handed back anyway
mutations.expectRed: an unreached plan carries no cut at all, rather than a plausible one
mutations.cell: and an unreached plan carries no cut at all, rather than a plausible one

mutations.name: a spawn in the cut is copied rather than refused
mutations.expectRed: a cut containing a spawn is refused: the fork would have to respawn an agent this host cannot mint
mutations.cell: a cut containing a spawn is refused: the fork would have to respawn an agent this host cannot mint

mutations.name: a step the journal never recorded is waved through
mutations.expectRed: with L5017 rather than a cut at the end of history
mutations.cell: with L5017 rather than a cut at the end of history

mutations.name: a divergence before the cut is reported as an unreachable step
mutations.expectRed: with L5001, the divergence, not with a cut refusal
mutations.cell: with L5001, the divergence, not with a cut refusal

mutations.name: the copy leaves the entries on the parent's run
mutations.expectRed: onto the CHILD's run, because the prefix is now the child's history
mutations.cell: onto the CHILD's run, because the prefix is now the child's history

mutations.name: forking into a run that already exists is allowed
mutations.expectRed: forking into a run that already exists is refused: a fork mints a new run
mutations.cell: forking into a run that already exists is refused: a fork mints a new run
